data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for launching arbitrary Android intents.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter apps to launch Android intents by specifying actions, categories, data, and extra arguments. It also provides methods to query whether an activity can handle a given intent.
use_when: You need to launch custom Android intents or set extra parameters not supported by generic URL launchers.
You need to query whether an Android activity can handle a specific intent.
avoid_when: You are targeting iOS (the plugin crashes on iOS).
Simple URL launching or deep linking is all you need and url_launcher suffices.
strengths: Enables full power of Android intents including actions, categories, and custom extras bundles.
Supports checking and resolving activities that handle specific intents.
weaknesses: Android-only; not supported on iOS and will crash if invoked there.
Does not support returning the result of the launched activity.
data.setup_notes: Requires ensuring platform is Android before invocation and configuring package visibility queries in AndroidManifest.xml if using query methods.
